subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

There is a whole world / out there that / is invisible from / the naked eye.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **is invisible from**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error here lies in the choice of the correct preposition.
 
• Replace "**from**" with "**to**" in order to correct the sentence.
 
• **From **is used to refer to the place where someone or something starts or originates.
 
• **To **is used to indicate the person or thing that receives or experiences the object of the verb.
 
• Here, the action is "**invisible**" and the receiver is "**the naked eye**."
 
• So, the preposition "**to**" should be used here.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 2**, which contains an error in it.

 

**Corrected sentence:** *There is a whole world out there that is invisible to __the naked eye.*
